info.name: Dataiku Govern API
info.description:
Public REST API for interacting with Dataiku Govern to manage AI governance workflows, including blueprints, blueprint versions, artifacts, custom fields, sign-offs, reviews, roles, and compliance workflows for responsible AI management.

Contact Support:
 Name: Dataiku Support
 Email: support@dataiku.com
